steps.command:
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
LC_ALL=C
export LC_ALL
as_root() {
  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
    "$@"
  else
    sudo -n "$@"
  fi
}
as_root sh -s <<'BASH_MATRIX_SEED'
# POSIX sh; works with GNU coreutils and BusyBox. No guest Python dependency.
set -eu
umask 022
LC_ALL=C
TZ=UTC0
export LC_ALL TZ
seed_root=/srv/legacy2/cross-file-accounting-reconciliation
staging=
trap '[ -z "$staging" ] || rm -f "$staging"' 0
trap 'exit 1' 1 2 15

safe_dir() (
    [ ! -L "$1" ] || { printf 'Symlink directory: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
    if [ -e "$1" ]; then
        [ -d "$1" ] || exit 1
        return
    fi
    safe_dir "$(dirname "$1")"
    mkdir -m 0755 "$1"
)

destination() {
    case "$1" in ''|/*|..|../*|*/../*|*/..) exit 1;; esac
    path="$seed_root/$1"
    safe_dir "$(dirname "$path")"
    # Check every existing parent, not just the final directory.
    [ "$(cd "$(dirname "$path")" && pwd -P)" = "$(dirname "$path")" ] || exit 1
}

regular_destination() {
    [ ! -L "$path" ] || exit 1
    if [ -e "$path" ]; then [ -f "$path" ] || exit 1; fi
}

verify_regular() {
    actual=$(sha256sum "$path")
    [ "${actual%% *}" = "$1" ] || exit 1
    [ "$(stat -c '%a' "$path")" = "$2" ] || exit 1
    [ "$(stat -c '%Y' "$path")" = "$3" ] || exit 1
}

safe_dir "$seed_root"
destination "$(printf '\142\151\156\057\162\145\143\157\156\143\151\154\145\056\160\171')"
regular_destination
staging=$(mktemp "$(dirname "$path")/.seed-XXXXXX")
base64 -d > "$staging" <<'BASH_MATRIX_FILE'

BASH_MATRIX_FILE
chmod 755 "$staging"
touch -t 202311142213.20 "$staging"
mv -f "$staging" "$path"
staging=
verify_regular 840acd464fa325117c10405c3c2e8428d1ba7ac6abbbe3d370ae7670dbec97da 755 1700000000
